name: CoinSwitch
about: CoinSwitch is one of India's largest cryptocurrency platforms, with over 25 million registered users. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Bangalore, it aggregates liquidity from multiple global exchanges to offer users the best real-time prices for trading over 400 cryptocurrencies in Indian Rupees (INR).CoinSwitch App (formerly CoinSwitch Kuber): A beginner-friendly mobile app designed for everyday investors. Users can start investing in cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH) with as little as ₹100. It also features automated Crypto SIPs to help manage market volatility.CoinSwitch PRO: A web and mobile-based platform tailored for advanced and professional traders. It supports spot trading, futures, API trading, and allows multi-exchange trading from a single account.CoinSwitch Ventures: The investment arm of CoinSwitch, which backs early-stage Web3 and blockchain startups.Security & Backing: The platform is backed by major investors like Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Tiger Global, and Sequoia Capital India. It mandates Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) verifications for all users and routinely publishes proof-of-reserves.
pros: Simple Interface: Highly rated for its clean, beginner-friendly UI that simplifies buying and selling crypto with INR.
Low Entry Barrier: Allows users to start investing with very small amounts.

name: Vantage Markets
accountTypes: Standard stp, Raw ECN, Pro ECN
about: A multi-regulated forex and CFD broker known for tight spreads, fast execution and a polished platform suite.Vantage Markets offers several live and demo trading accounts to suit different trading styles, experience levels, and capital requirements. The three primary live accounts include the Standard STP (commission-free), Raw ECN (lowest spreads), and Pro ECN (best for high-volume traders)
